description: Compare 2 to 4 perfumes or colognes side by side: notes they share, notes only one has, accords, family, audience, launch year, longevity and projection, plus plain-language differences ('A is fresher, B is sweeter and lasts longer') and how close they are overall. Use when someone is choosing between named fragrances or asks how two differ ('Sauvage vs Bleu', 'Delina or Layton', 'Aventus or Layton for summer'). Not for finding perfumes like one (use find_similar_perfumes) and not for one perfume's details (use get_perfume).

locale.description: Language of the 10ml.com links and labels.

perfumes.description: 2 to 4 perfumes, each a name with optional house or an id. Example: ["Dior Sauvage","Tom Ford Ombre Leather"]

response_format.description: concise (default) or detailed (adds pyramid, seasons, occasions, longevity).
